findings.summary: Rejected candidate 1496494a43c26ac9195947aa1aec4d439813ca45 could erase Unicode minus and leak valid required-term credit from unsupported or embedded numeric spans. The accepted candidate consumes complete numeric-adjacent and unsupported-scale spans as opaque, preserves sign semantics, and independently scores each of −1.8, 1.8e3, 7up, 1abc, and one trillion at exactly 800 milli recall in the five-term probe.

Rejected candidate 1496494a43c26ac9195947aa1aec4d439813ca45 normalized supported positive signs inconsistently and failed the supported no-comma word day/year form. The accepted candidate equates positive one, plus one, +1, and one; equates September fourth, twenty twenty-six with its no-comma form and September 4 2026; and keeps wrong day and wrong year distinct.

Independent review accepted exact candidate f66400cf8297b00d5b7ff932f378723322f2258a with no remaining findings. The reviewer independently passed all 34 Speech tests, checked the complete diff and exact clean remote candidate, and reused the valid schema, privacy, marker, and counterfactual evidence. Reviewer configuration was gpt-5.6-sol at high; native runtime telemetry and native reviewer identity were unavailable.
